comment: Dr. Coppage is a great professor who wants to see you succeed. He adds funny jokes and memes to his lectures to keep them lighthearted. Will give you as much credit as he can on exams. Funny and overall great class. Highly recommend.

Dr. Coppage is laid back and knowledgeable. The class can be a lot, but there are great practice tests and general material. I found that my lack of success was from my transition to college, not from the professor or how the class was taught.

Dr. Coppage is an amazing professor, I highly recommend taking him for Chem 141 if you can. He's extremely nice, great teaching style. Every lecture slide has a funny meme on it to lighten the mood, but you really get so much out of this class (a lot of effort but rewarding). super accessible outside of class for office hours (three times a week)

If you are taking chem141 you NEED it with Dr. Coppage. He is amazing, makes lecture fun, and thoroughly answers questions. If you have an a- you don't have to take the final. He really wants everyone to do well and does everything to raise your grade. Weekend quizzes that boost grade, extra credit, understanding, lecture not required. Take him.
The lectures are very well prepared and easy to understand. The class is very well organized and Dr. Coppage is great at lecturing and answering questions. I really recommend him for Chem 141!

I had Dr. Coppage for Gen Chem lab and for inorganic lab. Always great. Not too harsh of a grader, everything is pretty fair. He's also pretty personable and funny. Make sure to stop by his office to see Tater Tot, his adorable dog.

Dr. Coppage is the nicest guy ever. He's so understanding and really wants his students to do well. If you work hard and study and show up to class you will do well and he gives you lots of oppurtunities to raise your grade. He's super funny and can roast you so don't take it if you're sensitive

Coppage is a great professor, but definitely picks favorites. If you pay attention in class, read the textbook, and do the labs well and on time, you can succeed in the class. He can be very passive aggressive towards some students if he does not think they are putting in enough effort. I liked him, but others did not.

Dr. Coppage is a wonderful teacher. Practice tests look like the exams and he won't put things on them that he doesn't sufficiently cover in class. You definitely need to do work outside of class to stay on top, but that should be expected with the pace of 141. He's hard to schedule outside of his set office hours so try to make the time work.

His practice exams are similar to the actual exam. He lets you drop your lowest test grade with the final, but you have to keep the grade even if it's bad. He doesn't curve tests so only a few people have an A. He grades so harshly on lab. If you do everything, you get a 91. The quizzes are online. The course grade is 45% weighted on only 3 tests.

THE BEST LAB PROFESSOR. Tells you exactly what you need to do and gives helpful hints where needed. Doesn't expect perfection but will help you to do your best and give constructive feedback. Good sense of humor and relates well to students. Super cute dog too!

I would highly recommend Dr. Coppage. He gives clear instructions for what needs to be done during the lab period. Lab reports are fairly straight forward and he is accessible outside of lab for help. Not a terribly hard grader. He's a no-BS professor but pretty laid back.

Dr. Coppage is a sassy professor who, on some days is in a great mood, and on others, not so much. He grades the labs tough, as he only gives an A for students who make zero mistakes and go above and beyond. That being said, he always helps students find the answers to their questions, and he helps out in lab if you ask.

Dr. Coppage is the man. This class is reasonably difficult if you don't have a strong chem background, however, the practice tests are exactly like the real exam, just with different numbers. He offers tons of extra credit on each exam which helps boost your grade. Overall, I would recommend him to anyone looking for a great 141 professor.

Fantastic professor and person. Cares about his students deeply. Class is fast-paced by nature but if you do the reading and the homework, you can keep up. Tests are hard, so study diligently. Always brings candy and cookies to tests for motivation. Memes on the slides keep it engaging, even through the are cheesy. Amazing guy.

Dr. Coppage is an amazing teacher who cares about how his students. He always offers office hours and is willing to review material. It is very fast paced so I don't recommend skipping classes because you WILL fall behind. Do the homework and the readings and you're set to pass the class with a high grade.

I had Dr. Coppage for Chem 141 lab. He was ok. He seemed pretty unapproachable when a student had a question. He also came across as very condescending at times. Overall, it wasn't a big deal because it was only a lab. Grading was pretty easy and our TA was great.

If you are considering taking chem141 I highly recommend this class. Mr. Coppage is passionate about chemistry and always open to answering questions. The way he taught the material was very organized and easy to learn. As long as you study for the tests and do the optional homework problems this class should be a breeze.

Dr. Coppage is an excellent chemistry professor. You can tell that he is passionate about what he teaches and very knowledgeable. Had him for lab and lecture. The pacing is very fast so you have to be prepared to put in work outside of class. Tests are manageable and fair and there are weekly quizzes. Hw is optional but in your best interest to do

Had him for lab. He was happy to answer questions I had about the chemistry underlying what we were doing. Lab environment was chill; he played music and had memes on the slides when he used slides. A solid choice for lab.

Dr. Coppage seemed bothered when students reached out to him outside of class, and did not do much in the lab since we had a TA. Dr. Coppage is a bit unapproachable (and since he had a TA, he really didnt have to interact much with us), but this may be because it was lab, not lecture. Regardless I will be avoiding future classes and labs with him.

Dr. Coppage is truly amazing. He is such a good professor! You really learn the material which will help you in further chem classes. There is a lot of homework and weekly quizzes. Dr. Coppage is accessible outside of class. His class is entertaining and you will definitely not be bored. Definitely got me to enjoy chem!

Dr. Coppage provides all the necessary resources for students to do well in his class. He gives practice exams that are similar to the actual exams, extra credit bonus exams, AND extra credit on the actual exams. HW problems are also optional. He uses his humor, however cringy it may be, to keep people's attention during lecture. Awesome professor!

Dr. Coppage does a great job of using jokes to keep class energy up. He encourages class participation during lectures and gives extremely fair tests that are very similar to the practice tests. Expect lots of chocolate and baked goods.

Coppage thinks he is hilarious (hes not) but thats what makes him so funny. Coppage is a great professor and everything he assigns is fair. You will have an online quiz every weekend but the answers are all online. Tests are easy because the test is exactly like the practice exam which is a blessing.
Good lectures, but jokes are cheesy. Lots of assignments, online quizzes, and practice tests. The class is hard, but if you do all the "optional" stuff, its a recipe for an A.

he's a great professor- he has clear goals and gives practice tests before the exams that are very similar to the real test. if you do all of the work he assigns as "optional" and extra credit you will really know the material. he makes a ton of cheesy jokes that make sure everyone is engaged in class. he is a great guy as well- really recommend.

Really engaging and fun classes. Tries to make the material easy with shortcuts and practice questions but his weekly quizzes are hard. The tests are doable if you do his practice exams (they are almost the same always). Very helpful and can really make you like the course even if it's for a gen ed. Amazing Professor with the quirkiest interests :)
Visiting professor at U. Richmond. Taught me lab chemistry. Hilarious, friendly and just a great professor. I can't speak for his lectures but definitely take him for labs.

Good teacher. Tries hard. Cracks jokes, though sometimes they are more cheesy than funny. Gives extra credit. Definitely go to class and always work the practice exams. He tries to help everyone do well and is available to sit in his office and work problems.  Pretty funny, but not as funny as he thinks he is.
